readout_other: Visual evoked potentials (VEPs) to hemifield checkerboard stimuli; behavioral hemifield discrimination accuracy
direction_notes: Online TUS to the left early visual cortex reduced VEP amplitude at 60-100 ms and slowed P1 latency for contralateral (right hemifield) visual stimuli processed by the targeted hemisphere, with no such effect at the non-targeted right-hemisphere control site.

exposures.label: Online TUS to left early visual cortex during hemifield visual stimulation

timing.protocol_description: Each trial consisted of a single 500 ms continuous-wave pulse, time-locked to begin 400 ms before a 20-ms checkerboard visual stimulus. Each block comprised 100 trials (50 stimulation, 50 no-stimulation, alternating) with a 4.0 s inter-trial interval; 5 blocks were administered per session.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twenty healthy volunteers (14 female, 20–60 years old, mean = $3 2 . 5 , \mathrm { S D } \pm 1 2 . 9 )$ , participated in the study and were recruited via online advertising and posters distributed in the local community.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: MRI sessions were followed by online TUS sessions at least one week apart, during which TUS was applied to the target during the visual task.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: We used the NeuroFUS TPO system (Brainbox Ltd., Cardiff, UK) with a 500 kHz central frequency transducer.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.isppa_w_cm2: The spatial peak pulse average intensity (ISPPA) in water was kept consistent $\operatorname { a t } \sim 4 0 \ \mathrm { W / c m ^ { 2 } }$ for all participants.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: Corresponding pressure values averaged at 0.31 ± 0.09 MPa in the ROI, $0 . 3 9 \pm 0 . 0 7$ MPa in the soft tissue, and 0.52 ± 0.13 MPa in the skull.

Paper does not describe participant or experimenter blinding to TUS vs. no-stimulation trials; not stated.

Study used a within-subject no-stimulation (NoS) control condition rather than a sham/placebo transducer condition; classified as sham_type none since there was no separate sham arm, only active-vs-no-stimulation trials.
